Ledger mapping of account balances; written in transfer, transferFrom, allowanceAndtransfer and read by balanceOf/_send/totalSupply.

Owned constructor assigning owner = msg.sender at deployment.
Access-control modifier requiring msg.sender == owner; guards allowanceAndtransfer, Burn, BurnSize and initialise.
Checked addition library function used for all balance and supply increases.
Checked subtraction library function used for all balance and allowance decreases.
Checked multiplication library function (supply scaling).
Checked division library function.
Returns _totalSupply minus the balance held at address(0).
Returns the balance of a given token owner.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to a recipient; requires recipient != zeroAddress and debits/credits balances.
Sets the allowance of a spender for msg.sender with no checks or return-value handling.
Spender-driven transfer; lazily initialises zeroAddress, calls _send and debits allowance and balance.
Returns the remaining allowance for a spender.
Owner-only function that sets burnAddress and mints an arbitrary amount of tokens to an arbitrary address, increasing _totalSupply.
Owner-only setter for the burnAddress2 whitelist entry.
Owner-only setter for the queueNumber threshold used by _send.
Internal view guard that enforces the zero-address transfer policy using zeroAddress, burnAddress, burnAddress2 and queueNumber.
Payable fallback that immediately reverts, rejecting plain ether transfers.
Owner-only function that pushes the entire contract balance to msg.sender via a raw value transfer.
Deployment constructor that initialises name/symbol/decimals, mints the whole supply to msg.sender and configures burn addresses and queueNumber.
Empty payable fallback that accepts ether into the contract (drained by initialise).

balances[to].add(tokens) arithmetic balance increase in transfer.

edges.reason: The stored owner state variable is compared against msg.sender inside the everyone require statement.
msg.sender is the value checked against owner in the everyone modifier.
allowanceAndtransfer is gated by the everyone modifier, restricting minting to the owner.
Burn is gated by the everyone modifier, restricting burnAddress2 configuration to the owner.
BurnSize is gated by the everyone modifier, restricting the queueNumber threshold to the owner.
initialise is gated by the everyone modifier so only the owner can drain the contract balance.
owner is assigned from msg.sender in the Owned constructor.
The constructor sets owner = msg.sender and mints the entire supply to msg.sender.
initialise reaches the raw value transfer that pays out address(this).balance.
The transfer recipient is derived from msg.sender, so the caller receives the full contract balance.
The local _owner variable is directly used as the recipient of the balance transfer.
transfer executes the balance debit for msg.sender.
transfer executes the balance credit for the recipient.
The caller-supplied tokens amount is subtracted from the sender balance.
The caller-supplied tokens amount is added to the recipient balance.
msg.sender indexes the balance that is decremented.
balances mapping is read and rewritten during the subtraction.
balances mapping is read and rewritten during the addition.
allowanceAndtransfer increases the total supply with the supplied amount.
allowanceAndtransfer credits the target balance with the supplied amount.
The tokens parameter flows directly into the total supply addition.
